name: @orchdesk/desktop
description: OrchDesk 桌面壳（Electron 主进程 + 渲染层桥接）
author: OrchDesk Team

scripts.build: node scripts/check-version.cjs --allow-tagged && pnpm run build:main && electron-builder
scripts.dist: node scripts/check-version.cjs && pnpm run build:main && node kill-running.cjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-version.cjs && pnpm run build:main && node scripts/vendor-dsh.cjs && node kill-running.cjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: node scripts/check-version.cjs && pnpm run build:main && node scripts/vendor-dsh.cjs && node kill-running.cjs && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.verify: pnpm run build:main && node scripts/check-version.cjs docs && node ../../scripts/verify-plugins.mjs && node ../../scripts/intent-gate-verify.cjs && node ../../scripts/verify-orchestration.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-trace-upload.mjs && node agent-runtime-verify.cjs && node model-catalog-verify.cjs && node dsh-runtime-verify.cjs && node step-extension-verify.cjs && node step-t4-verify.cjs && node step-session-verify.cjs && node step-t5-verify.cjs && node step-model-bridge-verify.cjs && node ipc-guard-verify.cjs && node credentials-verify.cjs && node data-dir-verify.cjs && node data-port-verify.cjs && node session-fork-verify.cjs && node memory-promotion-verify.cjs && node memory-summarize-verify.cjs && node connector-registry-verify.cjs && node connector-discover-verify.cjs && node plugin-market-verify.cjs && node session-merge-verify.cjs && node usage-registry-verify.cjs && node session-events-verify.cjs && node ts-loader-verify.cjs && node browser-tools-verify.cjs && node terminal-pty-verify.cjs && node file-panel-verify.cjs && node file-edit-verify.cjs && node arch-guard-verify.cjs && node mcp-client-verify.cjs && node ipc-mcp-verify.cjs && node event-emit-verify.cjs && node e2e-fix-verify.cjs
scripts.version:show: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const v=p.version;const{execSync}=require('child_process');const tags=execSync('git tag --sort=-version:refname').toString().trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);console.log('version:',v,'| latest tag:',tags[0]||'none','| total tags:',tags.length)"
scripts.release: pnpm run changelog && pnpm run version:bump && pnpm run dist
